fields.name: Call of Dutyо: Modern Warfareо III
fields.description: In this direct sequel to the record-breaking Modern Warfareо II, Captain Price and Task Force 141 confront the ultimate threat: the ultranationalist war criminal Vladimir Makarov. Experience a gripping campaign, a vast collection of multiplayer mapsЧincluding all 16 launch maps from the original Modern Warfareо 2 (2009)Чand an all-new open-world Zombies mode.

fields.name: Halo Infinite
fields.description: Step into the armor of humanityТs greatest hero, Master Chief, to confront the most ruthless foe he's ever faced in an expansive open-world campaign. Halo Infinite offers a dynamic free-to-play multiplayer experience with over 70 maps, billions of customization options, and various game modes, including ranked, custom games, and the wave-based survival mode, Firefight: King of the Hill.

fields.name: DOOM Eternal
fields.description: HellТs armies have invaded Earth. Become the Slayer in an epic single-player campaign to conquer demons across dimensions and prevent humanity's final destruction. Experience the ultimate combination of speed and power in DOOM Eternal, featuring a shoulder-mounted flamethrower, retractable wrist-mounted blade, upgraded guns, and new abilities. Engage in the new 2 versus 1 multiplayer experience, BATTLEMODE, where a fully-armed DOOM Slayer faces off against two player-controlled demons.

fields.name: Quake II Remastered
fields.description: Quake II returns with enhanced visuals, classic levels, and a new expansion. This remastered version includes updated visuals for HD resolutions, improved enemy models and animations, enhanced lighting, and support for anti-aliasing and depth of field. It features the classic Ground Zero and The Reckoning mission packs, the full version of Quake II 64, and a new expansion called Call of the Machine, which includes 28 new single-player levels and a new multiplayer deathmatch map.

fields.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
fields.description: You are Geralt of Rivia, a mercenary monster slayer. Explore a war-torn, monster-infested continent and track down CiriЧthe Child of Prophecy, a living weapon that can alter the shape of the world. Winner of over 800 awards, including Game of the Year in 2015, The Witcher 3 offers a vast open world, rich storytelling, and immersive gameplay.

fields.name: Cyberpunk 2077
fields.description: Cyberpunk 2077 is an open-world, action-adventure RPG set in the dark future of Night CityЧa dangerous megalopolis obsessed with power, glamor, and ceaseless body modification. Play as V, a cyberpunk mercenary, and customize your character's cyberware, skillset, and playstyle. The game has undergone significant updates, enhancing its performance and gameplay experience.

fields.name: ELDEN RING
fields.description: Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring and become an Elden Lord in the Lands Between. ELDEN RING offers a vast, fantastical world filled with peril and discovery. Developed by FromSoftware, Inc., this critically acclaimed fantasy action RPG combines challenging combat with a richly detailed open world.

fields.name: DARK SOULSЩ III
fields.description: Dark Souls will continue to test players' mettle in a new chapter of the acclaimed, award-winning series that has defined the face of the genre. Gather your courage and plunge into the darkness!

fields.name: Portal 2
fields.description: The "Perpetual Testing Initiative" has been expanded to allow you to design co-op puzzles for you and your friends. Portal 2 builds upon the original's innovative gameplay, introducing new characters, puzzle elements, and a cooperative mode. Solve mind-bending puzzles using the portal gun in a humorous and engaging storyline.

fields.name: Forza Horizon 5
fields.description: Your Ultimate Horizon Adventure awaits! Explore the vibrant and ever-evolving open-world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in hundreds of the worldТs greatest cars. Forza Horizon 5 offers diverse environments, dynamic weather events, and a deep campaign with hundreds of challenges.

fields.name: Need for SpeedЩ Heat
fields.description: Hustle by day and risk it all at night in Need for SpeedЩ Heat, a thrilling race experience that pits you against a cityТs rogue police force as you battle your way into street racingТs elite. Customize your cars, explore an open world, and compete in various events to rise through the ranks.

fields.name: F1о 24
fields.description: Experience the thrill of Formula 1о in F1о 24, featuring all the official teams, drivers, and circuits from the 2024 FIA Formula One World ChampionshipЩ. Compete in career mode, challenge friends in multiplayer, and immerse yourself in the most realistic F1о racing simulation to date.

fields.name: Assetto Corsa Competizione
fields.description: Assetto Corsa Competizione is the official GT World Challenge game, offering an unparalleled racing simulation experience. Featuring real-world tracks, advanced physics, and dynamic weather conditions, it's the perfect choice for racing enthusiasts seeking realism and precision.

fields.name: Metro Exodus
fields.description: Leave behind the ruins of the Moscow subway and once again embark on a journey through the post-apocalyptic lands of Russia. Large non-linear levels, an open world and an exciting storyline await you.
